query.rawSQL: SELECT DISTINCT provider FROM bkit_perf_runs ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(mn.normalized_model, r.model) FROM bkit_perf_runs r LEFT JOIN model_normalization mn ON r.model = mn.raw_model ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT tool FROM bkit_perf_runs ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT workload_mode FROM bkit_perf_runs ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest results per model (all tools)
panels.description: Latest run per model, provider and tool at or before the End date variable.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT r.*, COALESCE(mn.normalized_model, r.model) AS model_name, CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(r.run_ts) AS timestamp) AS run_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY COALESCE(mn.normalized_model, r.model), r.provider, r.tool ORDER BY r.run_ts DESC) AS rn
    FROM bkit_perf_runs r
    LEFT JOIN model_normalization mn ON r.model = mn.raw_model
    WHERE r.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})
      AND COALESCE(mn.normalized_model, r.model) IN (${model:sqlstring})
      AND r.tool IN (${tool:sqlstring})
      AND r.workload_mode IN (${workload_mode:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(r.run_ts) AS timestamp) <= CAST('${end_date}' AS TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT
    model_name AS model,
    provider,
    tool,
    workload_mode,
    num_concurrent_requests AS concurrency,
    run_time AS run_ts,
    ROUND(client_ttft_s_p50, 3) AS ttft_p50_s,
    ROUND(client_ttft_s_p90, 3) AS ttft_p90_s,
    ROUND(client_output_token_per_s_per_request_p50, 1) AS tok_s_per_req_p50,
    ROUND(client_end_to_end_latency_s_p50, 2) AS e2e_p50_s,
    ROUND(client_total_output_throughput, 1) AS total_tok_s,
    ROUND(error_rate * 100, 2) AS error_pct,
    num_requests AS requests,
    run_id
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY model, provider, tool

FROM bkit_perf_runs r
LEFT JOIN model_normalization mn ON r.model = mn.raw_model
WHERE r.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})
      AND COALESCE(mn.normalized_model, r.model) IN (${model:sqlstring})
      AND r.tool IN (${tool:sqlstring})
      AND r.workload_mode IN (${workload_mode:sqlstring})
      AND CAST(from_iso8601_timestamp(r.run_ts) AS timestamp) <= CAST('${end_date}' AS TIMESTAMP)
  AND client_output_token_per_s_per_request_p50 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time
